# Skydio X2 model

`x2.xml` is copied unmodified from [MuJoCo Menagerie](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie),
directory `skydio_x2`. It is licensed under the Apache License 2.0, © 2022 Shadow Robot Company Ltd;
the full licence text sits beside it in `LICENSE`.

It is used here as a test input. The mesh and texture it references are not vendored, because nothing in this repository reads them.
